review_type: Visual comparison of actual model renders against the cited plans and exterior photographs; not a measured survey
retained_features: Complete three-storey Building B main envelope with top-floor north/south overhang
Separately traced 1F western rooms, north meeting room, south services and eastern glass pod
Separately traced 2F inset west classrooms, north colonnade, larger east block and south services
North L-return external stair, separate lift shaft, open route beside eastern pod and open corridor
South low black metal canopy and open vertical-bar screen
Own traced platform, northeast rounded corner, north/east steps and bounded southwest descending entry edge
Four unequal rooflight footprints: one longer west strip and three shorter east strips
Conservative west boundary with neutral wall faces and only the small plan-confirmed third-floor landing/stair
excluded_features: Western L block and glass connector
Adjacent A/C/M/N blocks, neighboring stairs and campus bridge
Central quad, lawn, trees, people and detached structures
Underground interiors, deep foundations, invented rooftop equipment and extra floor
explicit_unknowns: Individual raised/sloped rooflight profiles; shallow neutral abstractions are not an as-built roof reconstruction
West elevation opening heights and material details; no east-facade mirror
Exact window, stair and screen counts, joint positions, structural dimensions and metric scale
Individual photo capture dates and any later changes; this is the published 2018 renovation exterior approximation, not verified 2026 state
visual_iteration: Reflected the south-positive source-plan Y coordinate at mesh export and corrected winding/camera positions so the delivered right-handed model renders source-consistent north/east/west orientation.
Replaced the initially buried small western landing treads with visible shallow step geometry, without extending toward the neighboring block.
Made unobserved lower west wall faces neutral rather than treating them as verified finishes.
Preserved actual stair underflight voids rather than adding support columns or a solid core; exposed the resulting unsupported slice start in the printing limitations.
numerical_iteration: Welded a 0.001 mm display-coordinate grid, removed collapsed index triangles and retessellated one exactly collinear triangle-edge pair without moving surface vertices. Rechecked edge and vertex manifoldness.
Verified seven clear line samples through the actual delivered STL, including open north circulation, the east-pod gap and the rounded platform exterior.
Separated actual upward-facing rooflight material patches to verify four light planes and one longer versus three shorter visible lengths.
printing_limitations: Single connected closed mesh is not a support-free print guarantee.
One new unsupported section start at model Z=18.3 mm in the north stair / turning landing zone; needs support evaluation.
0.72 mm principal frames/bars are thickened simplifications; some color boundaries are finer.
No physical print test or extrusion toolpath validation.
